s-welcome.title: Welcome
checks: Logo and tagline are centered near the top of the window.
Three action cards sit in a row: New project, Open folder, Open sample rocket.
A Recent list shows each project's name and path with a relative time or a status, and a missing project is marked and can be removed.
A version footer sits at the bottom.

s-new-project.title: New project
checks: A modal dialog is centered over a dimmed Welcome screen.
It has a Name field and a Location field with Choose and a preview of the resulting path.
Template choices are shown as cards (Empty, Minimal, Simple rocket).
Cancel and Create project close the dialog's footer.

s-project-menu.title: Project menu
checks: A dropdown hangs under the header's project control on the Design page.
The current project is listed first, with a check mark.
A Recent section lists other projects, with a missing one marked.
New project, Open folder, Open sample rocket, Rename project and Close project follow, separated from the lists.

s-add-part.title: Add part
checks: A popover opens from the Components plus button.
It has Part types and Parts library tabs and an Attach to dropdown.
Part types form an icon grid, four columns wide.

s-context-menu.title: Tree context menu
checks: A context menu opens on a part tree row.
It offers Rename, Duplicate, Move to and Delete.
Delete is drawn in the danger colour.

s-sim-conditions.title: Simulation conditions
checks: A side sheet on Results is titled Simulation conditions with the simulation's name.
Groups cover Launch, Site, Wind, Atmosphere and Solver, with two-column fields that carry units.
Revert and Save and run are the sheet's actions.
The sim's row reads Not run and offers a Run button.

s-check-issues.title: Check issues
checks: A panel is anchored under Check model.
Errors and Warnings are separate groups.
Each row has an icon, a code, a message, the part, and Go to part.
Run check again is offered, and the part is outlined in teal in the viewport.

s-liquid-editor.title: Liquid engine editor
checks: Propulsion's Properties tab shows cards for Propellants, Chamber, Nozzle and Tanks, with editable fields.
New engine and Duplicate are available.
An edited engine reads Modified, needs recompute, in amber.
A result strip shows Isp, chamber and throat diameter next to Compute.
